concepts.name: 입체 고급형
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one polished design candidate for a donation animation in a dark desktop streaming app. Input image 1 is the identity reference of the user's official mascot Doreumi. Preserve its white rounded pear-shaped body, two small arms and two legs, tiny black oval eyes, gentle mouth, pink cheeks, dark navy curled crest ABOVE the head and a dark navy spiral emblem on the belly. Do not turn it into an animal or a generic ghost. Show ONLY ONE mascot and ONE umbrella, full body and full canopy in frame, ample margin. It must be HOLDING the umbrella physically in its hand: an unmistakable enclosed grip with fingers/mitten silhouette around the real umbrella shaft, never attached to its head, never a disconnected overlay. This is a beautiful coherent illustration, not an existing flat PNG glued under an SVG. Capture a plausible drifting-down pose, with gravity, natural hand and arm posture and the body hanging from the grip. Plain solid charcoal #1e1e21 backdrop matching the app, no environment, no ground, no floor shadow, no text, no letters, no emojis, no watermark. Square high-resolution composition. Premium stylized 3D matte porcelain character, midnight navy fabric umbrella with warm antique gold brass ribs and curved handle. Soft cinematic studio lighting, tasteful premium finish, restrained colors. One hand firmly wrapped around the shaft just above the curved handle, the other arm relaxed; knees softly bent, body suspended slightly sideways under the canopy, believable load-bearing grip.
